signIn.subject: Sign in to Slotly
signIn.title: Sign in to Slotly
signIn.intro: Click the button to sign in, or enter the code:
signIn.note: The link and code are valid for 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

signUp.subject: Confirm your email for Slotly
signUp.title: Confirm your email
signUp.intro: Click the button to confirm your address, or enter the code:
signUp.note: The link and code are valid for 1 hour. If you did not sign up for Slotly, you can ignore this email.

booking.subject: Confirm your booking on Slotly
booking.title: Confirm your booking
booking.intro: Check the details and click the button to confirm your booking, or enter the code on the booking page:
booking.note: We are holding this time for you until {time} ({zone}). If you did not book, you can ignore this email.

emailChangeNew.subject: Confirm your new email for Slotly
emailChangeNew.title: Confirm your new email
emailChangeNew.intro: Click the button to sign in to Slotly with {email} from now on.
emailChangeNew.note: The link is valid for 1 hour. If you did not change your email, you can ignore this email.

emailChangeCurrent.subject: Confirm the email change on Slotly
emailChangeCurrent.title: Confirm the email change
emailChangeCurrent.intro: Your Slotly account asked to change its address to {email}. If this was you, click the button.
emailChangeCurrent.note: The link is valid for 1 hour. If this was not you, do nothing and your address stays the same.
